card.name: Linking words after season or month names
card.fires_on: The word 'is', 'are' or 'the' right after a season or month name used as the subject, just before a description such as 'the cruellest month' or 'the wettest months'.

modes.label: Season or month as subject
modes.description: A linking verb or 'the' follows a month or season, ahead of a superlative or a 'time to visit' phrase.
modes.example: April is<< the>> cruellest month. In the poem

modes.label: Other 'is' after a defined noun
modes.description: A weaker case where 'is' follows a general noun that is about to be defined.
modes.example: Altitude or height<< is>> defined based on the context in which it

card.writes: It likely prepares words meaning a period of time or season, such as 时期 and 高峰期.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after a month or season name, when the text is about to say what kind of period it is.
